message.reasoning_content:
The user wants two things:
1. A summary of the causes of the French Revolution in five paragraphs
2. A list of ten key dates

Let me organize my thoughts on the causes of the French Revolution:

Paragraph 1: Social/economic structure - the Three Estates system, the burden on the Third Estate, feudal privileges
Paragraph 2: Financial crisis - national debt from wars (Seven Years' War, American Revolution), mismanagement, tax system that favored nobility and clergy
Paragraph 3: Enlightenment ideas - philosophical influence (Rousseau, Voltaire, Montesquieu), ideas about natural rights, social contract, challenging divine right of kings
Paragraph 4: Political factors - weak monarchy (Louis XVI), inability to reform, the Estates-General, the failure of the parlements
Paragraph 5: Immediate triggers - bread prices, poor harvests of 1788-1789, the calling of the Estates-General in 1789, the Tennis Court Oath

Now for ten key dates:
1. May 5, 1789 - Estates-General convenes at Versailles
2. June 17, 1789 - Tennis Court Oath (Third Estate declares itself the National Assembly)
3. June 20, 1789 - Louis XVI is forced to acknowledge the National Assembly
4. July 14, 1789 - Storming of the Bastille
5. August 4, 1789 - Abolition of feudalism
6. August 26, 1789 - Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
7. October 5-6, 1789 - March on Versailles
8. June 20, 1791 - Flight to Varennes (Louis XVI attempts to flee)
9. September 21, 1792 - Battle of Valmy / Fall of the monarchy
10. January 21, 1793 - Execution of Louis XVI

Let me refine these dates to be the most significant ones:

1. May 5, 1789 - Estates-General opens
2. June 17, 1789 - Tennis Court Oath
3. July 14, 1789 - Storming of the Bastille
